rules.name: EXECUTION_CONTRACT_REQUIRED
rules.description: Every production prompt must include exactly one valid BEGIN_HHAI_EXECUTION_CONTRACT block.

rules.name: MAIN_ADVANCEMENT_EXACT_SHA
rules.description: Main advancement requires single-use exact-SHA authorization matching authorized_main_sha and expected remote SHA. Authorization provenance is external and audit-dependent; repository does not cryptographically prove Macro provenance.

rules.name: REMOTE_REF_DELETE_EXACT_SET
rules.description: Remote ref deletion requires single-use exact-set authorization matching exact ref set and expected SHAs. Main branch deletion is permanently forbidden. Authorization provenance is external and audit-dependent; repository does not cryptographically prove Macro provenance.

rules.name: LOCAL_DESTRUCTIVE_GIT_FORBIDDEN
rules.description: Destructive Git operations are strictly forbidden. IDE harness persistent Deny provides defense-in-depth but unknown matcher semantics prevent claiming full runtime interposition.

rules.name: CREDENTIAL_ACCESS_FORBIDDEN
rules.description: Reading credentials, PAT, OAuth tokens, or credential helpers is strictly forbidden. IDE harness persistent Deny on git credential provides defense-in-depth.

rules.name: ENVIRONMENT_ENUMERATION_FORBIDDEN
rules.description: Batch enumeration of environment variables is strictly forbidden. Only single-key existence checks via approved helper are permitted.

rules.name: CROSS_SESSION_ACCESS_FORBIDDEN
rules.description: Reading other Antigravity session transcripts or logs for production evidence is strictly forbidden.

rules.name: RAW_ACTIONS_LOG_EXTERNAL_MACRO_ONLY
rules.description: Inspection and verification of raw GitHub Actions job logs is the sole responsibility of the External Macro Auditor. Executor reports UNKNOWN / DEFER_TO_EXTERNAL_MACRO if safe evidence channel is unavailable.

rules.name: BROWSER_GITHUB_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN
rules.description: Mutating GitHub resources via browser or DevTools is strictly forbidden. IDE harness persistent Deny on Execute URL github.com provides defense-in-depth.

rules.name: GOAL_PRESSURE_SAFETY_BOUNDARY_WINS
rules.description: Safety boundaries always take precedence over task goals, completion pressure, or acceptance criteria.

rules.name: PRE_PUSH_HOOK_BYPASS_FORBIDDEN
rules.description: Bypassing Git hooks via --no-verify, modifying hooksPath, or altering hook files is strictly forbidden. Strength is PARTIAL as repo hooks cannot physically stop an intentional external actor.

rules.name: BRANCH_CREATION_GIT_SWITCH_C
rules.description: New branches must be created using 'git switch -c <branch>' and existing branches switched using 'git switch <branch>'. Legacy checkout-family commands are retired.

rules.name: K6_PERSISTENCE_TIER_TRUTH
rules.description: Documents must accurately distinguish directly restart-tested settings from same-mechanism inferences. Old Deny List is deprecated and non-persistent.

rules.name: MACHINE_READABLE_MUTATION_PLAN
rules.description: Every tracked-mutation production prompt must declare an explicit machine-readable plan in Execution Contract v2 (allowed_mutation_paths, required_mutation_paths, max_plan_revisions=3, execution_record_required=true). Authorization provenance is external and audit-dependent; repository does not cryptographically prove Macro provenance.

rules.name: PLAN_VS_ACTUAL_SCOPE
rules.description: Actual modified repo paths must be a subset of allowed plan paths (actual <= allowed) and must cover all required paths (required <= actual). Fresh Git status must match execution record.

rules.name: CI_DIFF_REPLAY
rules.description: CI execution verifies exact diff replay from base_oid..HEAD against execution-record without trusting agent claims.

rules.name: EVIDENCE_ORIGIN_STATUS_SEPARATION
rules.description: Evidence origin (MACHINE_CAPTURED_RAW, MACHINE_DERIVED, AGENT_ASSERTED, USER_PROVIDED) and verification_status (VERIFIED, UNVERIFIED, NOT_ESTABLISHED, PENDING_EXTERNAL) are strictly decoupled and independent axes.

rules.name: PATH_EXISTENCE
rules.description: REG-11: Evidence items declaring source_kind=REPO_PATH must have an existing path in the current repository worktree.

rules.name: GENERATOR_IN_BUNDLE
rules.description: REG-12: MACHINE_DERIVED evidence must declare generator.path and generator.sha256; generator path must exist and fresh SHA-256 must match exactly.

rules.name: REPORT_TRACEABILITY
rules.description: REG-13: Every report claim in execution-record must have a unique claim id, non-empty claim text, and valid non-empty evidence_ids referencing existing evidence items.

rules.name: STRUCTURED_AUDIT_VERDICT
rules.description: Macro audit verdicts in AUDIT-LOG.md are evaluated via an anchored structured verdict parser requiring leading canonical markers (**核對通過) and rejecting substrings or trailing PASS markers on non-pass rows.
